transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

...I guess they made me come in. From work. The warehouse. 

They said I keep... doing things. Like, sometimes I just freeze by the forklift. With my arms up. Or... I copy the beeping sounds it makes, and the hand signals. I was just moving boxes in... these little patterns. Everyone kept yelling for me to stop, but... I don't know. That's why I'm here.
When did you first start noticing these episodes of freezing or repeating sounds?
...I don't really know exactly. Maybe... about six months? That's when they started saying I was... acting strange at the warehouse. And that my talking was confusing. So... yeah, around six months.
Over these past six months, how has your mood been feeling?
...I don't know. It's just... fine, I guess. I haven't really thought about it.
Do you have any physical medical conditions or illnesses?
...No. I don't think so. Just... healthy, I guess.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people don't seem to hear?
...No. I don't... I don't hear things like that.
Have you felt like people are watching you, following you, or trying to harm you?
...No. I don't think anyone's doing that. Just... normal stuff. I just go to work and go home. That's all.
Have you ever had any seizures or convulsions?
...No. I've never... never had anything like that happen.
